title: Recoverable Depreciation the Insured Awaits, Set against Overdue Reconstruction Draws
content:
The company does not charge for carrier money the insured is still waiting for, as the base overdue rule carries no charge on carrier-funded draws while their funds are pending. On a past-due customer-funded draw of a Reconstruction contract, recoverable depreciation the carrier still holds is therefore set against the balance the overdue draw charge is figured on.

**Rule.** The recoverable depreciation set against the balance follows the carrier's release practice:

- when the claim arrangement has the carrier release recoverable depreciation only once the work is shown complete and the contract has no substantial completion date yet, it is the dwelling depreciation withheld on the linked claim file's approvals less the dwelling depreciation released and less the amounts written off as depreciation forfeited, never below zero;
- when the contract has a substantial completion date and the latest depreciation release request on the claim file, of two on that date the one with the larger requested amount, has no depreciation release payment received on or after its request date, it is that request's requested amount;
- otherwise no depreciation is set against it.

The release practice, approvals, write-offs, depreciation release requests and carrier payments are those of the linked claim file kept under Insurance Claim Services; the substantial completion date is the one on the Reconstruction contract.

## Combinations

| Arrangement releases depreciation only once work is shown complete | Substantial completion date on the contract | Latest depreciation release request | Set against the balance |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | none yet | — | withheld less released less forfeited, never below zero |
| no | none yet | — | nothing |
| any | recorded | none filed | nothing |
| any | recorded | filed, no release payment received on or after its date | that request's requested amount |
| any | recorded | filed, a release payment received on or after its date | nothing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Before completion, under an arrangement that releases only on shown completion: withheld $8,400.00, released $0.00, forfeited $600.00 — $7,800.00 is set against the balance.
- After completion: the latest release request, dated the 9th, asks $5,200.00, and the only release payment was received on the 2nd — $5,200.00 is set against the balance. Had a release payment been received on the 9th or later, nothing would be.
- Two requests dated the same latest day, for $1,900.00 and $2,300.00, with no release received since: $2,300.00.
